audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4], spikes[1] and mid all claim Infinite Duress 'ignores' or 'locks out' Shadow Dash and Spirit's Refuge.
audit.why: It is the reverse: Warwick's R is a channelled leap-suppress and Shen's Shadow Dash taunt cancels it, stranding a 110s ultimate. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, which does not stop the suppression but does blunt the follow-up autos.
audit.corrected: Ult only after Shadow Dash is spent (18s at rank 1); the taunt is stated as the thing that cancels your R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Primal Howl can interrupt Stand United.
audit.why: Stand United is a channelled teleport with a 200s cooldown at rank 1; Primal Howl's 1s fear inside 375 range breaks it, which is the single highest-value use of Warwick's E in this lane.
audit.corrected: Written into the first-item spike alongside the 200s timer.
sources: Shen kit R 'channel' flag and cd 200/180/160

audit.whatIsWrong: Every why-line says 'favours you' at 1, 3, 4-5 and 6 while the side rows say Skill or Shen — the page renders two different answers to the same question.
audit.why: The packet chart (Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Shen) matches the prose and the 50.33% win rate: Warwick owns the lane phase, Shen wins the game with global pressure and tank scaling.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart with ratings raised on the Warwick rows.

audit.why: Spike stages are right — Blood Hunt at 3, level 6, first item, and Shen's two-item tank scaling — and the level-6 spike now carries the real ordering rule.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you: R Infinite Duress ignores his E dash and W refuge, letting you burst him down.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you: ult once Shadow Dash (E) is spent — his taunt cancels Infinite Duress.

edits.before: R Infinite Duress locks Shen out of Spirit's Refuge (W) and Shadow Dash (E) — ult him mid-CS and you burst him before he can block or dash back to tower.
edits.after: Shadow Dash (E) taunts you out of Infinite Duress, so ult only once it is down — 18s at rank 1 — and then he cannot block or dash back to tower.

edits.before: Even at your first-item spike a fed Shen can Stand United (R) bot for a kill, so track his ult timer; the lane goes Skill here because you win the duel but he wins map value.
edits.after: A fed Shen turns Stand United (R) into bot-lane kills, so track that 200s timer — and if he starts the channel inside your 375-range Primal Howl, the fear interrupts it.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are yours: Blood Hunt speed catches him whenever he steps up, and Q healing off his minions keeps you topped through his poke. Land R at 6 and he can't Shadow Dash or Spirit's Refuge out of the burst.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are yours: Blood Hunt speed catches him whenever he steps up, and Q healing off his minions keeps you topped through his poke. At 6, bait Shadow Dash (E) first — his taunt cancels your R mid-suppress.

notes: Highest-value fix here is a reversed mechanic that appeared in three places: the page taught that Infinite Duress ignores Shadow Dash, when Shen's taunt actually cancels the channel. The mirror (shen__warwick) already teaches Shen to hold E for exactly that, so the two sides now agree. Chart set to the packet chart because the existing why-lines already described it that way — the side rows were the half that was wrong.
